name: Shenzhen SNC Opto Electronic Co.,Ltd
summary: Shenzhen SNC Opto Electronic Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of LED lighting products in China and internationally. The company offers outdoor lighting products, including LED street, wallpack, flood, post top pole, and high mast lighting products; and LED sports lighting, hazardous location LED lights, and LED grow lights.
